 Job description 
What are you going to do? As an all-round F&B Team Member, you will create memorable experiences for our guests throughout the day. You may start your shift serving breakfast, delight guests with delicious meals during lunch and dinner in our restaurant, or take centre stage at our banqueting events. In this versatile role, you will have the opportunity to grow and gain experience across all areas of our dynamic Food & Beverage department. No two days are the same and every shift brings new challenges, learning opportunities and guest interactions. We encourage you to develop your skills, broaden your experience and discover all aspects of the F&B operation.
